description: This file defines an interface for Twig template loaders, specifying methods that all loader classes must implement, such as retrieving source context, cache keys, freshness, and existence checks for templates.

classes.name: Twig"Loader"LoaderInterface
classes.description: Interface that all Twig loader classes must implement, including methods for source retrieval, cache key retrieval, freshness checking, and existence verification.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context for a given template by its name.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Provides a cache key for a specific template, used in caching mechanisms.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is still fresh based on its last modification time.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Verifies whether a template with the given name exists.
